data.one_liner: A customizable Speed Dial Floating Action Button widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Implements a Speed Dial Floating Action Button in Flutter supporting vertical, horizontal, and radial/carousel layouts. Allows configuring secondary action icons, callbacks, background glass effects, and animations.
use_when: You need a floating action button that expands into multiple secondary actions.
You want to display actions in vertical, horizontal, or radial layouts.
avoid_when: You only need a single standard floating action button without expandable options.
strengths: Supports multiple layouts including vertical, horizontal, and radial/carousel.
Includes customizable glass effects and background blurring.
Configurable animation duration, elevations, and icon rotations.
weaknesses: Testing coverage is incomplete according to the package ToDo list.
Relies primarily on community support for debugging new issues.
data.minimal_example:
SpeedDialFabWidget(
  layout: SpeedDialLayout.radial,
  radialRadius: 112,
  glassEffect: true,
  glassOpacity: 0.22,
  secondaryIconsList: const [Icons.copy, Icons.share, Icons.delete],
  secondaryIconsOnPress: [copyItem, shareItem, deleteItem],
)
